svg.title: Posterior spectral distortion after removing reused Laplacian-scale duplicates
svg.desc: At every draw budget and for each method,18 points represent the three graph seeds times six sampling replicates, with10 scale duplicates removed. Lines show descriptive medians. The dotted horizontal epsilon1 line marks the requirement epsilon<1 for the stated two-sided eigenvalue interval rule; crossing below it is not sufficient for conclusive certification. Epsilon is computed using dense reference eigensystems; no scalable or end-to-end runtime result is established.
